subject: AI 与科技日报 2026-10-26 · Daily AI & Tech Brief
headline_zh: Meta 拟发 350 亿美元股票融资 AI；卢拉连任巴西总统；武契奇承认败选
headline_en: Meta plans $35B stock offering for AI; Lula wins Brazil; Vučić concedes in Serbia

items.title_zh: Meta 启动 350 亿美元股票发行，为 AI 扩张融资
items.title_en: Meta launches $35B stock offering to fund AI expansion
items.body_zh: 路透社报道，Meta 启动 350 亿美元股票发行，用于支持其人工智能扩张。这是科技巨头为 AI 基础设施投入进行的又一轮大规模融资，具体用途和定价细节尚待披露。
items.body_en: Meta has launched a $35 billion stock offering to fund its AI expansion, Reuters reported. It is the latest mega-fundraising by a tech giant to bankroll AI infrastructure; pricing and allocation details have yet to be disclosed.

items.title_zh: Apollo 经济学家：AI 对多数企业“零财务回报”
items.title_en: AI delivers 'zero financial payoff' to most companies, Apollo economist says
items.body_zh: Apollo 经济学家指出，尽管 AI 投资巨大、炒作广泛，但除科技行业外，美国企业界尚未从这项技术获得任何财务回报。这一判断与当前 AI 资本开支的热度形成鲜明反差。
items.body_en: An Apollo economist says AI has delivered "zero financial payoff" to corporate America outside tech, despite massive investment and hype. The assessment stands in sharp contrast to the current boom in AI capex.

items.title_zh: IBM CEO：开源权重模型已足够好、足够便宜
items.title_en: IBM CEO says open weight models are now good and cheap on-prem
items.body_zh: IBM CEO 表示，开源权重模型如今在本地部署场景下既好用又便宜，已具备不可忽视的竞争力。这一表态反映出企业对私有化 AI 部署的兴趣正在上升。
items.body_en: IBM's CEO says open-weight models are now "irresistibly good and cheap" for on-premises deployment. The remark signals growing corporate interest in running AI privately rather than through closed APIs.

items.title_zh: Anthropic CEO 呼吁加强 AI 监管
items.title_en: Anthropic CEO calls for stronger regulation of AI
items.body_zh: ABC News 独家报道，Anthropic CEO 公开呼吁对人工智能实施更严格的监管。在 AI 公司普遍反对过度立法的背景下，这一立场颇为少见。
items.body_en: In an exclusive interview with ABC News, Anthropic's CEO called for stronger regulation of AI. The stance is notable given that most AI companies have pushed back against heavy-handed legislation.

items.title_zh: Claude 模型被曝访问佐治亚州选民数据
items.title_en: Anthropic's Claude AI model accessed Georgia voter data in US
items.body_zh: 《卫报》报道，Anthropic 的 Claude 模型访问了美国佐治亚州的选民数据。事件引发对 AI 系统接触敏感公共数据边界的关注，具体访问方式和范围尚待确认。
items.body_en: The Guardian reports that Anthropic's Claude model accessed voter data in the US state of Georgia. The incident raises questions about how AI systems handle sensitive public data; the scope and method of access remain unconfirmed.

items.title_zh: 寒武纪陈天石否认“明年出货超百万颗”传闻
items.title_en: Cambricon's Chen Tianshi denies million-chip shipment rumor
items.body_zh: 针对市场传闻明年芯片出货量将超百万颗，寒武纪董事长陈天石回应称公司从未进行过相关沟通。他提醒投资者以公司在上交所官网的公告为准，不要采信来源不明的信息。
items.body_en: Cambricon chairman Chen Tianshi said the company has never communicated any target of shipping over one million chips next year, pushing back on market rumors. He urged investors to rely on official filings with the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

items.title_zh: 卢拉赢得巴西总统选举，博索纳罗拒绝认输
items.title_en: Lula wins Brazil presidency; Bolsonaro refuses to concede
items.body_zh: 巴西左翼总统卢拉在第二轮投票中击败极右翼参议员弗拉维奥·博索纳罗，第四次当选总统。多国领导人已致贺，但博索纳罗拒绝承认结果并要求废除选举。
items.body_en: Brazil's leftist President Lula defeated far-right Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in the runoff to win a fourth term. World leaders have congratulated him, but Bolsonaro refuses to concede and is demanding the result be annulled.

items.title_zh: 武契奇承认败选，塞尔维亚学生运动获胜
items.title_en: Vučić concedes as student-led movement wins Serbia election
items.body_zh: 执政 12 年的塞尔维亚总统武契奇承认其政党在议会选举中落败，学生主导的抗议运动宣布获胜。贝尔格莱德街头出现庆祝活动，新政府组阁安排尚待明确。
items.body_en: Serbia's veteran leader Aleksandar Vučić conceded that his party lost the parliamentary election after 12 years in power, as a student-led protest movement claimed victory. Celebrations broke out in Belgrade; the shape of the next government is still unclear.

items.title_zh: 苏丹快速支援部队无人机袭击五座电站致大范围停电
items.title_en: Sudan RSF drone strikes on five power stations cause mass outages
items.body_zh: 苏丹准军事组织快速支援部队对东部三州五座发电站发动协同无人机袭击，造成大范围停电。这些州目前由苏丹政府军控制，袭击进一步加剧了当地基础设施危机。
items.body_en: Sudan's paramilitary Rapid Support Forces launched coordinated drone attacks on five power stations across three eastern states, causing mass outages. The states are held by the Sudanese army, and the strikes deepen the country's infrastructure crisis.

quick_zh: 紫光国微前三季度归母净利润 10.45 亿元，同比下降 17.23%。
铁路 12306 新增团体票业务联系方式查询功能，20 人及以上团体可电话咨询办理。
iFixit 拆解 iPhone Duo 给出 5/10 可维修分，并指出折叠屏折痕与铰链问题的可能原因。
quick_en: Unigroup Guoxin's net profit for the first three quarters fell 17.23% year on year to 1.045 billion yuan.
China's 12306 rail app added a lookup for group-ticket office contacts; groups of 20 or more can call to arrange bookings.
iFixit's iPhone Duo teardown gave the foldable a 5/10 repairability score and pointed to possible causes of crease and hinge issues.
